guard: an agent's session is held only while a view of it is open: one watch and one read per agent however many views, the watch before the read, nothing asked of an agent with no event plane, at most 2,000 events held, and only the agent's verified chat posts kept as its posts
why: This suite runs `tsx` directly over `client/src`, with no build step and no compiled second copy, so no `afterRestore` is needed on any mutation here.

mutations.name: S1 the session reads before it watches, so a frame published between the read and the watch reaches neither
mutations.expectRed: 2.1 the watch is issued before the read, and the read waits for the watch to be answered
mutations.cell: 2.1 the watch is issued before the read, and the read waits for the watch to be answered

mutations.name: S2 views are not counted, so closing one of two views unwatches the agent and forgets the session the other view still shows
mutations.expectRed: 1.2 one closeSession of two views keeps the session and unwatches nothing
mutations.cell: 1.2 one closeSession of two views keeps the session and unwatches nothing

mutations.name: S3 the cap check is removed, so a session holds every event it is sent and the browser's memory grows without bound
mutations.find: while (n > SESSION_EVENT_CAP && drop < frames.length) n -= frames[drop++].events.length;
mutations.expectRed: 7.1 2,001 events drop the oldest frame and set more
mutations.cell: 7.1 2,001 events drop the oldest frame and set more

mutations.name: S4 posts take history rows by the payload's own from, so an unverified row reads as the agent's own post
mutations.find: for (const m of s.open?.messages ?? []) take(m?.msg, m?.senderId);
mutations.replace: for (const m of s.open?.messages ?? []) take(m?.msg, m?.senderId ?? m?.msg?.from?.id);
mutations.expectRed: 9.3 a history row from the agent (no senderId) does not land in posts, seeded or live
mutations.cell: 9.3 a history row from the agent (no senderId) does not land in posts, seeded or live

mutations.name: S5 the card's off is ignored, so an agent that publishes no events is still watched and read
mutations.find: const off = entry !== undefined && rosterRows([entry], { includeOffline: true })[0]?.events === "off";
mutations.expectRed: 3.1 an agent whose row says off is neither watched nor read and ends ok
mutations.cell: 3.1 an agent whose row says off is neither watched nor read and ends ok

mutations.name: S6 a live frame is added even when its message is already held, so a frame read from history shows twice
mutations.expectRed: 4.3 a frame already held from history is not added twice
mutations.cell: 4.3 a frame already held from history is not added twice

mutations.name: S7 a reconnect forgets the open sessions, so the new feed is never asked to forward them and their live frames stop
mutations.find: for (const [id, life] of lives) if (life.plane) void syncSession(id, life, store.get().sessions[id]?.limit ?? SESSION_PAGE, true);
mutations.expectRed: 5.1 onHello after a reconnect watches every open session on the new feed and re-reads each at its limit
mutations.cell: 5.1 onHello after a reconnect watches every open session on the new feed and re-reads each at its limit

mutations.name: S8 Load earlier ignores the read ceiling, so it asks the server for more than its history limit accepts
mutations.find:
if (!s || !life || !s.more || s.limit >= SESSION_LIMIT_MAX || eventCount(s.frames) >= SESSION_EVENT_CAP) return;
      await syncSession(id, life, Math.min(s.limit + SESSION_PAGE, SESSION_LIMIT_MAX), false);
mutations.replace:
if (!s || !life || !s.more || eventCount(s.frames) >= SESSION_EVENT_CAP) return;
      await syncSession(id, life, s.limit + SESSION_PAGE, false);
mutations.expectRed: 6.2 loadEarlier steps by 200 and never reads above 2000
mutations.cell: 6.2 loadEarlier steps by 200 and never reads above 2000

mutations.name: S9 a refused read empties the session, so the reader loses what was on screen
mutations.find: putSession(id, (s) => ({ ...s, load: "refused", reason: page.refused, grant: page.grant }));
mutations.replace: putSession(id, (s) => ({ ...s, frames: [], load: "refused", reason: page.refused, grant: page.grant }));
mutations.expectRed: 8.1 a refusal keeps the held frames and sets the broker's reason and the grant
mutations.cell: 8.1 a refusal keeps the held frames and sets the broker's reason and the grant

mutations.name: S10 the card flag takes any string, so a card saying yes reads as a plane that is on or off
mutations.replace: return v !== undefined ? { events: v as "on" | "off" } : {};
mutations.expectRed: 10.2 and leaves events absent for true, "yes", or no key
mutations.cell: 10.2 and leaves events absent for true, "yes", or no key
